4. Repair the mobile footer shown in the screenshot
The attached mobile screenshot is the visual reference for this defect.
Figure 1. Current mobile footer with excessive vertical blank space caused by an uneven two-column layout.

The footer uses a two-column mobile grid. The left side contains collapsed groups such as Directory and For Business. The right side contains Explore and the expanded Stay in Style newsletter. The newsletter makes that grid row tall, while the short For Business cell remains at the top-left. This creates the large unused black area and pushes company and legal links far down the page.
